data_classification.description: Marks this record as generated portfolio data.

event_id.description: Unique event identity; a redelivery repeats the same value.

idempotency_key.description: Key used to prevent duplicate decisions for the same logical request.

event_time.description: When the payment happened at the source, UTC.

received_at.description: When the system received the event, UTC; used to observe late arrivals.

payment_token.description: Synthetic token for the payment instrument; never a PAN.

account_token.description: Synthetic stable account token for velocity features.

amount.description: Amount in major currency units, e.g. 12.34.

currency.description: Three-letter currency code; amounts are not mixed across currencies.

channel.description: Payment channel used by this project scenario.

country_code.description: Synthetic two-letter country code; not a raw IP address.

device_first_seen_days.description: Age of the device in days; zero means first seen today.

source_region.description: AWS Region label where the event entered the demo.
